limitations: Selected skin is an open subset; no closed hand volume or maximum overlap-volume depth claimed.
Two-axis section parity is a local geometric witness, not a proof of global axe manifold/closed solid status; disagreements are recorded.
Observed intrusion samples are actual skin vertices or barycentric triangle centroids, not an optimization over every continuous skin point.
